answer: Proof of unique compute: each identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by its own key, once per epoch, taking about 40 seconds on one core. An attacker running 200 fake identities needs 200 cores or 8000 seconds per epoch, so cost scales linearly with N while the reward stays fixed. A voyage of honest agents pays one puzzle each, trivial, like a zephyr. A river of clones drowns in cost. Cap: 1 puzzle per key per epoch.
